description.value: Ocean Sands Resort is a condominium-style resort set on 4 acres of oceanfront property overlooking Rathtrevor Beach in Parksville, offering one- and two-bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchens, gas fireplaces, and ocean or pool-view balconies. The resort sits above one of Vancouver Island's most celebrated beaches, reachable on foot in about five minutes. Nearby activities listed on the resort's website include mountain biking, kayaking, hiking, and wildlife viewing tours, making it a natural staging point for cyclists exploring the east coast of Vancouver Island.

address.value: Unit 21 1165 Resort Drive, Parksville, BC V9P 2E2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Ocean Sands Resort is an active oceanfront condominium resort in Parksville, BC. The amenities page and about page explicitly list laundry facilities and free Wi-Fi; no bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site. The phone number 1-877-733-5969 and address 1165 Resort Drive appear consistently across multiple website pages, corroborating the OSM data.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone sourced from website only.
Outdoor swimming pool noted on website as 'Closed for Repairs, Expected Opening Will be in June' — may be outdated as site copyright reads 2020.
Website appears to not have been redesigned since 2020; some content may be stale.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable resort with a functioning website and confirmed address. A legitimate overnight stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island's east coast.

Laundry.detail: About page states: 'The amenities include a heated outdoor pool, playground, indoor hot tub, sauna and laundry facilities.'
